facts.fact: The African Union Commission's status list of 02/02/2026 records Comoros as having signed the Convention on Cyber Security and Personal Data Protection on 29/01/2018, with no ratification or accession date and no deposit date.
facts.system: African Union Convention on Cyber Security and Personal Data Protection

facts.fact: As at 02/02/2026 the African Union Commission's list shows no ratification, accession or deposit by Comoros of the Convention, which entered into force on 8 June 2023 after the 15th ratification.
